Pack of 3 Women’s Underwear – Comfortable Lycra Banyan Fabric Panties for Everyday Wear, Available in Sizes S, M, and L – Soft, Stretchable, and Breathable Innerwear (Random Color)

This pack of 3 women’s underwear is designed to provide comfort, style, and practicality for everyday use. Made from high-quality lycra banyan fabric, these panties are soft, stretchable, and breathable, ensuring all-day comfort and a perfect fit. The lightweight material feels smooth against the skin and adapts to your body shape, making it suitable for daily wear under all types of clothing.

Each pack contains 3 panties in assorted random colors, adding variety and freshness to your lingerie collection. The stretchable waistband ensures a secure yet gentle grip without leaving marks, while the seamless design reduces irritation and provides a smooth look under jeans, dresses, skirts, or office wear.

Available in sizes Small, Medium, and Large, this set is perfect for women who want a balance of comfort and style. Whether you are at home, at work, or on the go, these panties deliver long-lasting support and breathability.

Practical, durable, and easy to maintain, this multipack offers great value with its mix of quality fabric, comfortable design, and attractive colors. It is an excellent choice for daily wear, travel, or as a thoughtful gift for women who appreciate both comfort and functionality in their underwear.
